asr.full_text: Hello, I am Ivan. Today I will show you to register in BitClub Network and pay the money. For this, a referral is required, and registration must be performed. Click Sign up. Here we show our login and enter the name and e-mail, our login, and password twice and click create account. It says you are happy with the registration, we are congratulated with registration to we are already in our back office for one thing to do is pay 99 membership, that is, this is a lifelong license, so we click upgrade account and now it shows us that we have to pay 99 dollars and give for this for 10 minutes for it Then we can get special code for paying So we must copy this wallet to our code and also to number of coins that we need to transfer. Enter the coins, instead of the dot, we put the semicolon, 99$ are displayed. Now click on SEND and we enter the password and click Send now we will see the notification that we are automatically paid Next, we click on Welcome, and below we have four options. 500 USD, 1K USD, 2K USD or 3.500 USD. If we choose one to choose between, it will provide us with any available options. And then we pay with the coupon that allows to sign up our partners. If you want to pay with the coupon only without license, you have to sign up here. so that we should register the partners and pay the fee. It won't allow us to pay just the license. So, we enter the wallet number, everything is automatically, we copy the amount of coins, which we must transfer, and press SEND. We go to the settings of the account and send the package for a while. The package was paid for RM 500. Go to the tab and the work will be done. Your login is already active. That is, you can invite your partners using the referral link. Hopefully this video will help you find a pay-per-view registration. Thank you, Ivan! See you soon!
